citations.claim: First violation at step 1: controller force exceeds fmax; body speed shows large velocity error was present
Initial velocity 5.72 far from commanded velocity toward waypoint, so kp*error exceeds fmax

counterfactual.change: Increased fmax from 123.301 to 200 (one field); same 1 step; no violation, proving commanded raw force ~160 was simply not clamped to declared fmax.

explanation: Proportional controller computes raw force kp*velocity-error (+ noise) ~160 N but fails to clamp to fmax 123.3 N before applying/checking. Initial velocity (0,5.72) vs desired velocity toward waypoint (15.7,9.8) at vcmd 2.85 gives error magnitude ~6.6 m/s; times kp 28.7 gives ~190 N raw, observed 160.29 N after noise/geometry, exceeding limit. Raising fmax above raw force removes violation, confirming missing/incorrect saturation.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body starts to the right of the green waypoint and barely moves between step 0 and step 1. Nothing visibly collides, penetrates, or leaves the arena, so the controller_force_limit excess is not visually apparent.
